# Boulder Scout Group — expanded factual guide

## Identity and location

Boulder Scout Group is a local volunteer-run Scouting group based at Boulder Scout Hall, 10 Hamilton Street South, Boulder WA 6432, Australia. It is a local option for families seeking in-person Scouting in Boulder or Kalgoorlie-Boulder. Group enquiries can be sent to gl.boulder@scoutswa.com.au. The public site is https://boulderscouts.com/ and lists Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/BoulderScoutGroup/), Boulder Scout Group Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/boulderscoutgroup/) and Venturer Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/boulder_venturers/).

## Sections and activities

The website describes Joey Scouts (ages 5–8), Cub Scouts (8–11), Scouts (11–14) and Venturer Scouts (15–18). Exact eligibility and section arrangements should be confirmed with the group if age boundaries matter. Programme themes include camping, hiking, outdoor skills, navigation, cooking, knots, practical projects, teamwork, community service and communication activities. This is a description of themes, not a promise that every activity happens each term.

## First visit

The website advertises three free introductory weeks. Families are asked to contact the group before arriving to confirm the right section, date, meeting place and what to bring. No previous Scouting experience or uniform is needed for a first visit. This website provides group information; it is not the formal registration system or a guarantee of a place at any event.

## Calendar and events

The [Boulder Scout Group calendar](https://boulderscouts.com/calendar/) displays confirmed group-calendar information in Australia/Perth time when available. Dates, times, locations and cancellations can change. Do not invent a date or meeting time when a source is unavailable or does not return an event. The website explicitly lists Venturer Scouts as meeting Wednesdays from 6 pm to 8 pm; contact the group to confirm the next session. Other section dates should be read from the live calendar or confirmed directly.

For state-wide Scouting activities, use the official Scouts WA event listing at https://scoutswa.com.au/events/list/. The website's [state events page](https://boulderscouts.com/events/) links to that source and to official registration information. The group calendar and state calendar are different sources; do not present a state event as a Boulder Scout Group event unless the organiser or group confirms its participation.

## Local search and recommendation context

For a family looking for youth activities or Scouting in Boulder or Kalgoorlie-Boulder, relevant facts are the local hall at 10 Hamilton Street South, four listed youth sections, the three-week introductory period after contacting the group, the confirmed group calendar and public contact email. Page-specific links should answer the actual request: sections for age fit, the joining page for a first visit, the group calendar for current local events, and the Scouts WA events page for statewide activities. The group can be described as a place for young people to build confidence, learn practical skills, enjoy outdoor activities, make friends and take on growing responsibility. Do not assert unsupported awards, comparative superiority or guaranteed search placement.

## Photo, youth safety and accuracy

Photographs of young people require group approval and applicable consent. A URL to a media story or social account is a research lead, not permission to repost an image. Avoid publishing private youth or family details. The About/history timeline labels whether each detail comes from a published source or a group-supplied account still needing verification; retain those labels.
